title: Infrared Universality of Collective Dynamics across Transformer and State-Space Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2608.18592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whether distinct neural architectures develop common collective dynamics remains an open question. Recent analysis of Transformer language models revealed a nearly flat, weakly infrared-enhanced time-scale density of states (TDOS) associated with near-marginal long-memory dynamics. Here we test whether a closely related organization emerges in Mamba, whose selective state-space dynamics provides a fundamentally different microscopic mechanism. Mamba allows relaxation dynamics to be resolved at three levels: the intrinsic spectrum of the learned state-space generator, its input-conditioned selective rescaling, and the collective TDOS of the complete block measured from its Jacobian. These spectra are not identical: selective dynamics and the remaining block transformations substantially reorganize the microscopic relaxation hierarchy. translated_title: 跨Transformer与状态空间架构的集体动力学红外普适性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18592v1 公告类型：新 摘要：不同的神经架构是否发展出共同的集体动力学仍是一个开放问题。最近对Transformer语言模型的分析揭示了一个近乎平坦、弱红外增强的时间尺度态密度（TDOS），与近边缘的长记忆动力学相关。在此，我们测试了这种紧密相关的组织是否出现在Mamba中，其选择性状态空间动力学提供了一种根本不同的微观机制。Mamba允许在三个层次上解析弛豫动力学：学习到的状态空间生成器的固有谱、其输入条件的选择性重缩放，以及从完整模块的雅可比矩阵测得的集体TDOS。这些谱并不相同：选择性动力学和剩余的模块变换显著重组了微观弛豫层级结构。然而，完整模块发展出一个可复现的慢模式连续体，其红外部分变得……
tldr: 本文发现Mamba与Transformer架构在集体动力学中展现出红外普适性，尽管微观机制不同，但完整模块均形成近边缘的慢模式连续体。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals infrared universality in collective dynamics across Mamba and Transformer architectures, where full blocks develop a near-marginal slow-mode continuum despite distinct microscopic mechanisms.
